# At the bakery window

- Author: Rowan
- Published: 2019\-09\-09
- Event: The Saturday before this post
- Recorded: Unknown

Original locator: move\-post\-01

Exact source text (untrusted):

```text
Two days after moving, the yellow mug is still on the windowsill. Kit carried the books up two flights on Saturday. We never did find the little saucepan that day; Mum had packed it inside the large one. The room over the bakery smells like warm flour before I wake up.
```
